Title: Register then login returns a bearer token
Steps: 1. POST register with valid unique user 2. POST login with same credentials
Expected Result: Register returns 201; login returns 200 with a non-empty access token

Title: Product listing returns products
Expected Result: 200 response with a non-empty product array

Title: Full cart-to-invoice flow
Steps: 1. Create cart with bearer token 2. Add a product with quantity 2 3. GET cart and check totals 4. POST invoice with billing + cash-on-delivery
Test Data: Bearer token from TC-API-01; valid product id
Expected Result: Cart create returns 201; add item returns 200; invoice create returns 201 with an id/invoice number

Title: Login with wrong password is rejected
Steps: 1. POST login with a valid-looking but wrong email/password combo

Title: Duplicate registration email is rejected
Steps: 1. Register a user 2. Register again with the same email
Expected Result: First call returns 201; second call returns 409 or 422

Title: Add item to cart without auth token is rejected
Steps: 1. Attempt to create/add to a cart without an Authorization header

Title: Invoice generation with an invalid cart_id fails cleanly
Steps: 1. POST invoice with a non-existent or already-invoiced cart_id
Expected Result: 4xx response with an error message; no invoice created
